step2.title: Get AI-Powered Answer

step3.title: Take Informed Action
step3.description: Use the information to understand your legal situation and decide on next steps.

about.title: About IndicLaw AI
about.subtitle: We're on a mission to make legal information accessible to everyone in India, bridging the gap between complex legal systems and everyday citizens.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description1: At IndicLaw AI, we believe that understanding the law should not be limited by language barriers or complex legal jargon.
vision.description2: Our vision is to democratize access to legal information across India, empowering citizens to make informed decisions about their legal matters.

technology.title: Our Technology
technology.point1: Advanced AI trained on Indian legal frameworks and precedents
technology.point2: Natural language processing in multiple Indian languages
technology.point3: Document analysis capabilities for legal paperwork
technology.point4: Continuous learning and improvement from user interactions

footer.description: Making legal information accessible to everyone in India through AI-powered assistance in multiple languages.
